packageRules.description: The checks image runs ansible-core, which supports Python 3.15 only from 2.22 (3.15 removed dataclasses._is_type, which ansible-galaxy 2.21 calls). Lift this once ansible-core 2.22 is out.
TypeScript 7 compiles kayra, but typescript-eslint (and the immutability rules built on it) supports TypeScript below 6.1 only. Lift this once typescript-eslint supports 7.
